parameters.query:
INSERT INTO market_signals (title, source_url, signal_type, source, project, description, published_at, created_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.title }}',
  '{{ $json.link }}',
  '{{ $json.signal_type }}',
  '{{ $json.source }}',
  'future-horizons',
  '{{ $json.description }}',
  CASE WHEN '{{ $json.pub_date }}' = '' THEN NOW() ELSE '{{ $json.pub_date }}'::timestamptz END,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (source_url) DO NOTHING;
